title: デビュー戦の後に・意外な弱点

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suffering from malnutrition, Tamamo Cross feels faint after the race. I ask her why she chooses to eat small portions…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She explains that it's to do with her impoverished upbringing. After sharing most of her food with her younger siblings, her stomach has shrunk over time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an effort to prove that her tiny diet won't hold her back, Tamamo Cross challenges the hulking Hishi Akebono to a sumo wrestling match…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the results speak for themselves… Hishi Akebono seized victory against Tamamo Cross by thrusting her out of the ring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With victory practically impossible at this rate, I concoct a plan to strengthen Tamamo Cross's body before next spring. In the meantime, we'll build up our racing experience by entering smaller races.
